moments.author: Sal Frelick
moments.why: Captured the emotion of his game‑tying World Series homer and became a rallying cry online.

moments.author: Sam Dekker
moments.quote: You cannot kill the Milwaukee Brewers. They are the villain in a horror movie; you sprint and they just keep walking with bullets in their face and arms chopped off.
moments.why: Vivid metaphor capturing fan awe at Brewers’ repeated comebacks on the biggest stage.

moments.author: CC Sabathia
moments.quote: No lead is safe against Milwaukee. Definition of resilience!!
moments.why: From a respected baseball veteran, underlines the brewing narrative of Milwaukee’s unstoppable postseason grind.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: This is what I will be doing.
moments.why: Provocative promise to give SpaceX shares to every kid in America is driving buzz and debate.
